of interest or importance at the present time 当前所关心的；时下重大的

ex.s: “It can bring a new interest and focus into people’s lives and help to make the link between home and nature.”
ex.t: “它可以给人们的生活带来新的兴趣和焦点，并有助于建立家与自然之间的联系。”

defs.def: functioning correctly, so that it is connected to another document or page on the Internet 电子链接

ex.s: Americans live in a(n) 11___, while the British live in a(n) 12___.
ex.t: 美国人住在……而英国人住在……

ex.s: Whatever our hobbies, the Internet can connect us with others who also enjoy doing them, even if they live on the other side of the world.
ex.t: 无论我们的爱好是什么，互联网都能让我们与那些也喜欢这些爱好的人建立联系，即使他们生活在世界的另一端。

ex.s: As Aristotle said, no one would choose to live without friends, even if he had all other goods.
ex.t: 正如亚里士多德所说，没有人会选择没有朋友的生活，即使他拥有所有其他好东西。

ex.s: You see, the West is a pretty big proposition, and I kept hustling around over it pretty lively.
ex.t: 你看，西部是一个相当大的生意，我一直非常活跃地四处奔波。

ex.s: There, they were welcomed to the Chinese-style compound where they were to live.
ex.t: 在那里，他们被欢迎进入他们将要居住的中式院落。
